Who We Are
MAX GENE LLC is a Riyadh-based general trading company supplying high-quality industrial products, safety equipment, tools, and maintenance materials to enterprises across Saudi Arabia.

We partner with globally recognised manufacturers to source and deliver products that meet the stringent demands of industrial, commercial, and construction environments.

Our Products
MAX GENE LLC
01
Safety & PPE Equipment
Comprehensive PPE and safety gear meeting international standards for head, eye, respiratory and body protection.
  • Hard hats, safety helmets & bump caps
  • Safety goggles, face shields & welding visors
  • Respiratory masks — dust, gas & full-face
  • Hi-vis vests, coveralls & flame-retardant suits
  • Safety boots, harnesses & fall-arrest systems
02
Hand & Power Tools
Professional-grade tools from globally recognised brands for maintenance, construction and workshop use.
  • Spanners, wrenches, ratchets & socket sets
  • Screwdrivers, pliers, hammers & chisels
  • Drills, grinders, circular saws & jigsaws
  • Torque wrenches & calibrated precision instruments
  • Cordless tool systems & compatible accessories
03
Industrial Hardware & Fasteners
Extensive catalogue of fasteners, anchors and structural hardware in standard and metric sizes, stainless and galvanised options.
  • Bolts, nuts, washers & threaded rods (DIN/ISO)
  • Chemical & mechanical anchors for concrete & masonry
  • Pipe clamps, strut channels & hangers
  • Wire rope, chains, shackles & lifting hardware
  • Stainless, galvanised & carbon steel grades

Our Products
MAX GENE LLC
04
Electrical Supplies & Components
Full range of electrical materials and switchgear for industrial and commercial installations, SASO and IEC compliant.
  • LV/MV cables — armoured, flexible & fire-resistant
  • Conduit systems — rigid, flexible & liquid-tight
  • MCBs, MCCBs, contactors & motor starters
  • Distribution boards, panels & enclosures
  • LED industrial & hazardous area lighting
05
Plumbing & Hydraulic Systems
Complete plumbing and fluid control solutions for water, oil, gas and chemical service in industrial facilities.
  • GI, CPVC, PPR & stainless steel pipes & fittings
  • Ball, gate, check & butterfly valves
  • Hydraulic hoses, fittings & quick-connect couplings
  • Pressure gauges, flow meters & level indicators
  • Water treatment chemicals & filter elements
06
Earthing & Lightning Protection
Complete earthing and lightning protection systems for industrial, commercial and infrastructure applications — ensuring electrical safety and equipment protection.
  • Copper-bonded & stainless steel earthing rods
  • Earthing plates, strips & clamps
  • Lightning arresters, surge protection devices & SPDs
  • Earth pit covers, inspection chambers & accessories
  • Earthing conductors, tapes & chemical compounds

Welding & Fabrication Supplies
Complete welding consumables for MIG, TIG, MMA and gas welding, including PPE, wires and positioning tools.

  • Level indicators, float switches & ultrasonic sensors
  • Gas detectors & environmental monitors
